closedFindings: Explanation explicitly preserves maxillary +1 mm and mandibular +3 mm and no longer asserts mandibular space deficiency.
Choice a now addresses chin-cap indication rather than relying on a nonexistent mandibular space shortage.
All five Japanese tooth-notation expansions remain consistent with the previously inspected original crop; original image remains authoritative.

C80.decision: GO as an explicitly limited, source-backed explanation
closedFindings: The explanation and choice a now expressly reject making extraction decisions from grade-2 mobility alone.
The extraction answer is attributed to this examination's official E rather than claimed as a rule for all mobile primary teeth.
The text distinguishes a possible oblique root-region radiolucency from a definite fracture-level diagnosis.
The promise that extraction avoids injury to the permanent successor has been removed.
The author records the IADT 2020 primary source used for the treatment distinctions.
C80.acceptanceScope: All five choices are addressed with the evidentiary limits stated. This is acceptable for publication as a cautious explanation of the official case answer and the relevant general distinctions. It is not acceptance of a definitive radiographic fracture diagnosis or a fully established case-specific mechanism excluding every alternative treatment.
C80.retainedUncertainty: Exact root-fracture level and full clinical extraction indication remain unconfirmed by this reviewer and are correctly not asserted in the corrected text.
